description: Figure 7 illustrates the performance of different query selection strategies during training, as measured by MRR@10. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis represents the MRR@10 score, with a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. There are three lines shown on the plot. The first line, colored red and marked with a circle, represents “CAPSTONE-DPR w/o max”, starting at approximately 35.68 at x=0 and ending at approximately 35.64 at x=10. The second line, colored green and marked with a square, represents “CAPSTONE-DPR w/ max”, starting at approximately 35.45 at x=0 and ending at approximately 97.28 at x=10. The third line, colored blue and marked with a diamond, represents “CAPSTONE-DPR w/ median”, starting at approximately 35.64 at x=0 and ending at approximately 97.28 at x=10.
